3 قايشهُ , (TA,) inf. n. فِيَاشٌ (S, O, K) and مُفَايَشَةٌ, (O, K,) He vied, or contended, with him in glorying, or boasting, or in glory, or excellence. (S, * O, * K, * TA.) ―
-b2- Also, (TK,) inf. n. مُفَايَشَةٌ, (Ibn-'Abbád, O, K,) He threatened him much in fight, and then was pronounced a liar. (Ibn- 'Abbád, O, K, TK.) ―
-b3- See also 1.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
